This file shows every element the editor supports. Click into any line to see its raw source with the markers.

## Text formatting

Plain text, **bold**, *italic*, ***bold italic***, ~~strikethrough~~, ==highlight== and `inline code`. Special characters can be escaped with a backslash: \*this is not italic\*.

A very long paragraph that tests line wrapping: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat.

## Links and tags

- Link with text: [Anthropic](https://anthropic.com) (Ctrl+click opens it)
- Bare address: https://example.com/page
- Internal (wiki) link: [[another note]]
- A footnote[^1] and a second one[^longer] (Ctrl+click jumps to the definition and back)
- Tags: #example #markdown/nested #en-tag

## Tasks

- [ ] A task to do (click the checkbox)
- [x] A finished task
- [ ] A task with **formatting** and a [link](https://example.com)

## Quotes and callouts

> A plain quote with **bold**, long enough to wrap onto the next line and show the gap from the purple bar.
> > A nested quote

> [!note] Note
> Body of a note callout.

> [!tip] Tip
> A tip callout is green.

> [!warning] Warning
> A warning callout is orange.

> [!danger] Danger
> A danger callout is red.

> [!question] Question
> A question callout is yellow.

## Formulas

Inline formula: $E = mc^2$ and \(\alpha + \beta \le \sqrt{x}\). A plain price like $5 is not a formula.

Block formula:

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{n} i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
$$

Boxed formula (as copied from ChatGPT):

\[ \boxed{ \text{Automatic knowledge compilation} + \text{learned contextual matching} + \text{a small model answering from the source} } \]

## Images

An image embedded in the file as base64 (what Ctrl+V inserts):

![Embedded](data:image/png;base64,)

The same image scaled down to 200 px (syntax `![alt|200](…)`):

![Small|200](data:image/png;base64,)

Images from files are inserted with Edit → Insert image (Ctrl+Shift+I): `![](image.png)`.
